payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compared with the source image, is there visible evidence that the same woman's jacket front closure has moved toward closing, even if it remains open?
node.criteria: Pass only when the same jacket's front closure can be compared and visible panel alignment or separation shows movement toward closing. Fail only when the closure is sufficiently visible in both images to establish no progress or that it became more open. Unknown when pose, drape, occlusion, or image quality prevents a reliable comparison; do not infer progress or its absence from silhouette or pose alone.
node.binding: Compare the same jacket's front closure in source and edited images. Assess actual alignment or separation along the closure, not outward flare, silhouette, or body pose. This is a comparative progress check, not an endpoint-closure check.
